changelog:
Closing the picture-in-picture window now stops the channel, and switching to dark mode no longer stops what you are watching.

WHAT CHANGED

- Closing the picture-in-picture window, with its ✕ or by swiping it away, stops the channel and removes its notification. Before, the sound went on with no window and no way to stop it from the notification. Opening the window back up to full screen keeps playing, and so does the screen turning off while the window shows.
- Switching between light and dark mode, by hand or on a schedule, keeps the channel playing. Before, it stopped the channel and could leave a blank screen.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.6.1: two channels at once with a one-tap swap, the docked player, and the faster import of very large playlists.
